name: forecast_vs_forecast
description: Compare two forecast snapshots to understand what moved between cycles. Surfaces new items, removed items, timing changes (push-outs, pull-ins), and amount changes. Includes forecast drift analysis and bias detection across rolling periods. Triggers: forecast vs forecast, FvF, forecast comparison, forecast drift, what changed in the forecast, compare F1 to F2, what moved between forecasts, forecast accuracy, forecast bias, are we forecasting worse, forecast roll-forward, forecast version comparison.
